workflow_description: Standardizing the extraction and mapping of data from varied sources—including POCOs, DataTables, and Dictionaries—into a structured internal table format while enforcing schema constraints like column-row parity.
Dynamically managing table dimensions and text layout by calculating Unicode-aware widths and executing multi-line wrapping at defined word boundaries.
Configuring and applying uniform formatting policies, specifically numeric right-alignment and cell padding, to improve the readability of statistical data across all ingestion methods.

Transforming structured data into multiple presentation styles, such as Markdown or minimal text, and directing the resulting output to the console or alternative streams while preserving visual integrity.
integration_test: [Fact] public void Workflow_MultiFormatReportGenerationAndRouting_ValidatesVisualIntegrityAcrossStreams() { var table = new ConsoleTable("Item Name", "Quantity"); table.AddRow("Laptop 💻", 5); table.AddRow("Sparkles ✨", 125); var testWriter = new StringWriter(); table.Configure(o => { o.OutputTo = testWriter; o.NumberAlignment = Alignment.Right; o.EnableCount = true; }); table.Write(ConsoleTables.Format.Default); var defaultOutput = testWriter.ToString(); testWriter.GetStringBuilder().Clear(); table.Write(ConsoleTables.Format.MarkDown); var markdownOutput = testWriter.ToString(); testWriter.GetStringBuilder().Clear(); table.Write(ConsoleTables.Format.Minimal); var minimalOutput = testWriter.ToString(); testWriter.GetStringBuilder().Clear(); table.Write(ConsoleTables.Format.Alternative); var alternativeOutput = testWriter.ToString(); Assert.Contains("| Item Name  | Quantity |", defaultOutput); Assert.Contains("| Laptop 💻  |        5 |", defaultOutput); Assert.Contains("Count: 2", defaultOutput); Assert.Contains("| Item Name  | Quantity |", markdownOutput); Assert.Contains("|------------|----------|", markdownOutput); Assert.Contains("| Sparkles ✨ |      125 |", markdownOutput); Assert.Contains("Item Name    Quantity", minimalOutput); Assert.Contains("Laptop 💻    5", minimalOutput); Assert.DoesNotContain("|", minimalOutput); Assert.Contains("+------------+----------+", alternativeOutput); Assert.Contains("| Item Name  | Quantity |", alternativeOutput); }
